dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin pumps while kitties dump - same old crypto circus!  
Elon winks, Vitalik thinks, and Web3 dreams sink.  
Render's AI hype? Just another coin to snipe.  
NFTs scream art, but my wallet says scam.  
Buckle up, degens, this market's a jam!

Bitcoin's mooning, Solana's pumping, but Dogecoin's still the people's champ.  
AI coins? Overhyped tech bro dreams.  
SEC's out here playing whack-a-mole with Coinbase.  
Web3's cool, but NFT bros still selling JPEGs for millions.  
HODL or get rekt, plebs. 🫡
